logline: Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana for poisoning the Duchess despite the bedridden matriarch's protests, uncovering Juliana's true noble identity and her mother's herbarium before ordering her to the castle dungeons.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 27 as Rupert orders the guard to seize Juliana, ignoring the waking Duchess.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as the guard drags Juliana toward the doorway, wrestling her backward.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana struggles against the guard's grip; the leather-bound herbarium slips from her apron pocket and falls to the stone floor.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Heavy thud of the leather journal hitting the polished floor.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle close-up of the leather-bound herbarium on the floor as Catherine's silk slipper steps down hard upon its embossed cover.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine plants her embroidered shoe deliberately atop the fallen book.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot tracking Catherine as she strides gracefully across the chamber toward Juliana, Rupert standing stoically behind her near the bed.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Cruel)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Look at her, Rupert.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Scoffing)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Soot on her face...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Catherine as she faces Juliana, who is pinned in the doorway by the guard.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Accusing, Smug)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: ...herbs in her pockets...

segments.label: CATHERINE (Cold)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: ...a secret medicine in her hand.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Catherine's smiling face, her eyes gleaming with vindictive pleasure.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Venomous)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: She looks exactly like a poisoner.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana glaring back in fierce indignation, breathing heavily as she resists the guard's arm across her shoulder.

segments.label: JULIANA (Furious, Defiant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium full shot of Rupert standing beside the four-poster bed, calmly pulling on his black leather gloves.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sardonic, Chilling)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: A clever story, girl.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Threatening)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: But the guards know how to extract the truth.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess stirring against her pillows, lifting her trembling head with visible effort.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Weak, Straining)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: Rupert...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert pausing mid-stride as he hears his mother's voice, slowly turning his head toward the bed.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (O.S.) (Commanding)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: Stop this!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Firm)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: She is innocent.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Adamant)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: She saved me!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.

segments.label: JULIANA (Breathless, Relieved)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Your Grace...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Shouting)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: I know what happened to me!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Fierce, Condemning)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: I was poisoned!

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Accusing)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: And you... you knew!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Duchess lunging forward from the pillows, gasping for breath as she points toward Catherine.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Choking, Weakening)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: Catherine knew!

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Gasping)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: They have been—

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot as Juliana lunges across the room toward the bed, but the armed guard seizes her from behind and drags her back.

segments.label: JULIANA (Panicked, Screaming)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Let me help her!

segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Rupert smoothing down his black leather gloves, a chilling smile forming on his lips.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Feigning Concern)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: You see?

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sinister)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: The poison has clearly damaged her mind.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder shot of Rupert leaning menacingly over the gasping Duchess in bed.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Hoarse, Straining)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: I am not delusional!

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Condescending, Whispering)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Of course you are not.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Dismissive)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: You are merely confused.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile tracking shot of Catherine walking deliberately toward Juliana, speaking with airy cynicism.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Amused, Mocking)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists...

segments.label: CATHERINE (Smug)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: ...is the maid who claims to have discovered it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of Rupert turning sharply toward the guard, his eyes icy and authoritative.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Commanding, Resolute)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Catherine's gloved hands grabbing the delicate chain around Juliana's neck.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

segments.label: JULIANA (Crying Out)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: No!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine holding up the oval silver and amethyst pendant, inspecting it with disdain.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Insolent, Sneering)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana crying out in agony, writhing in the guard's iron grip.

segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Weeping)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Give it back!

segments.label: JULIANA (Anguished)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: It belonged to my mother!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot tracking the silver locket as Catherine casually flings it across the stone corridor floor.

segments.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Cruel)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: A witch has no need for family heirlooms in the gallows.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Metallic clatter as the silver pendant bounces against the wooden baseboard.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana being dragged further into the doorway, staring helplessly toward her discarded locket.

segments.label: JULIANA (Heartbroken)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: My mother's locket!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine walking toward the fallen leather-bound book and kneeling gracefully to pick it up.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine lifts the heavy herbarium, dusting off the cover before opening its aged parchment pages.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Catherine reading the elegant cursive script inside the front cover.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Intrigued, Murmuring)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Juliana...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on the handwritten inscription: 'Juliana Ashcroft'.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana freezing in the doorway as she sees Catherine opening her mother's book.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine raising her gaze slowly from the book, a wicked, triumphant grin spreading across her face.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Triumphant, Venomous)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as Catherine steps deliberately up to Juliana, circling her like a predator savoring its prey.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Reveling)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: I knew I had seen those eyes before.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: The disgraced daughter...

segments.label: CATHERINE (Scornful)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: ...the girl thrown out of her own family home.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up two-shot of Catherine leaning inches from Juliana's face, whispering her humiliating past.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Taunting)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: The bride who married a penniless war veteran...

segments.label: CATHERINE (Vicious)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: ...because no respectable man would have her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Juliana's eyes blazing with explosive fury and defensive loyalty.

segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Wildly Defiant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Do not speak about my husband!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as Catherine throws her head back in derisive laughter, brandishing the herbarium book.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Laughing, Scornful)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: And look at you now. Scrubbing fireplaces in my house.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Mocking)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert gesturing toward the exit with an outstretched arm.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Harsh, Authoritative)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine fanning open the illustrated botanical pages of the herbarium with gloved fingers.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Smug)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: And this?

segments.label: CATHERINE (Gleeful)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: This book of weeds will hang her before the magistrate.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the guard's grip, her arm reaching out toward the book.

segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: That book is my mother's life's work!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine smiling coldly, clutching the closed book against her bodice.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Icy, Threatening)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Then perhaps you can explain every page to the magistrate...

segments.label: CATHERINE (Fateful, Vengeful)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: ...before he sends you to the gallows.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eyes as the guard wrenches her backward into the dark hallway, cutting sharply to black.
